device: same 3528 white LED and same carrier tape

search.reduction: mean of all four source grayscale pixels in each 2x2 block
search.output_area: reduced foreground area times 4, estimate; 13-bit saturation
search.bbox: half-resolution component bbox mapped to 720p processing/display coordinates, padded by two pixels and clipped
search.border_acceleration: certify full four-pixel words connected to a physical border, skip them, reject remaining connected fragments on contact; dark-reference bits preserved

diagnostics: SIZE: strict image dimensions not met
ASP: strict image aspect not met
FILL: strict bright-body fill not met
REF: side dark reference not met

quality_classification.note: Presence and model diagnostics do not measure actual assembly quality or defect identity

metadata.late_result: one attachment to the same completed slot/writer epoch; canceled by next FS or bad frame; active reader tuple changes only at VS

recipe_loading: compile-time implementation; this JSON documents the experiment, not a runtime recipe loader

processing_clock.bridge: explicit 128x512 dual-clock ERAM FIFO with 10-bit Gray pointers and two-stage synchronization

validation: See final V11 audit and validation record; optical accuracy and onsite remain pending

optics.lens: same lens as user-reported working V10
optics.distance_measurement_reference: record actual start/end planes with new samples

processing.scaling: full-field separable bilinear 2/3 before detection and view processing

display.capture_fps: measured separately; display refresh is not capture FPS

geometry_recipe_status: V10 numeric limits retained only as uncalibrated debug seeds; not inferred by 2/3 or distance scaling
